title: Ticket sales
lead: Who can find the event, the public page that sells its tickets, and what is for sale. Buyers name each person coming on the public page.
forbidden: Your role on this event can’t change ticket sales.
refused: That was refused. Reload the page and try again.

visibility.heading: Who can find this event
visibility.askBody: Its announcement stops being public at once. Tickets already sold are unaffected.

PRIVATE.name: Private
PRIVATE.about: Only through invitation links. No announcement, no ticket sales.

UNLISTED.name: Unlisted
UNLISTED.about: Anyone with the announcement’s link can buy tickets; it isn’t listed anywhere and search engines never index it.

PUBLIC.name: Public
PUBLIC.about: The announcement can also be listed among Aveline’s public events.

announcement.heading: The announcement
announcement.lead: The public page that sells the tickets, at its own address.
announcement.didUnpublish: The announcement is no longer public. Tickets already sold are unaffected.

blockers.heading: It can’t be published yet:
blockers.private: The event is private: choose who can find it first.
blockers.headline: It has no headline in any language.

types.heading: Tickets for sale
types.lead: Each kind of ticket, its price and how many. A new price applies to future buyers only.
types.removeBody: Nobody has bought or is buying it, so it can be removed. This can’t be undone.

refusals.inUse: It has been sold, held or started at checkout meanwhile, so it can only stop being sold.
refusals.capacityTaken: More tickets were sold or held meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
refusals.gone: It is no longer on this event.
refusals.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t change ticket sales.

typeForm.priceNote: A new price applies to future buyers only; orders already placed keep theirs.
typeForm.taken: {{sold}} sold and {{held}} held now: not fewer than {{taken}}.
typeForm.windowNote: Both are optional. Sales also stop when the event starts. Once set, a date can be moved but not removed.
typeForm.goneBody: It is no longer on this event.

announcementForm.title: The announcement
announcementForm.lead: What buyers read on the public page, in each of the event’s languages. A language left empty shows the default language’s words.
announcementForm.headline: Headline
announcementForm.ogTitleHelp: Optional: the headline is used when empty.
announcementForm.categoriesHelp: Separated by commas: at most ten, each up to 40 characters.
announcementForm.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Left empty, one is made from the headline. The page: {{path}}
announcementForm.indexableHelp: Only for a public event; an unlisted one is never indexed.
announcementForm.buyerTicketLimitHelp: Optional. Leave blank for no event-wide limit.

errors.nameRequired: Give it a name in at least one language.
errors.price: Enter a price in the currency’s units, such as 15000.
errors.belowTaken: Not fewer than are already sold or held.
errors.minAboveMax: Not fewer than the least per order.
errors.dateAndTime: Give both a date and a time, or neither.
errors.skipped: The clocks skip this time on that day in the event’s time zone.
errors.invalid: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.endBeforeStart: Sales must close after they open.
errors.cannotClear: Once set, this can be moved but not removed.
errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
errors.slugTaken: Another event already uses this address.
errors.buyerTicketLimit: Enter a whole number between 1 and 100,000.

promoCodes: Promo codes, for all your organization’s events

inventory.title: Seat and zone inventory
inventory.noLayouts: No layouts yet. Ask a directory editor to publish one.
inventory.offers: Ticket prices offered in each section
inventory.warning: Publishing fixes this venue and layout for the show. Check your prices and blocked seats first.
inventory.noVenues: No directory venues are attached to this event.
inventory.attach: Use a directory venue to publish ticket inventory.
inventory.noTypes: No ticket types yet. Create ticket types before publishing inventory.
inventory.csvHelp: For large layouts, use one record per numbered seat and one per unnumbered zone.
inventory.csvSize: Choose a CSV file no larger than 8 MiB.

forbidden.read: You can’t read this event’s venues or layouts with your role.
forbidden.layout: Only Aveline’s directory editors can publish venue layouts. Ask Aveline to add or change one.
forbidden.publish: Publishing the inventory needs a role that can edit this event.

refused.gone: This venue or layout is no longer there. Reload the page.
refused.changed: This changed since you opened it, perhaps by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
refused.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Please wait a moment and try again.
refused.unreadable: The answer couldn’t be read. Please try again.
refused.invalid: That wasn’t accepted. Check the sections, rows and seats:
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. Please try again.

errors.key: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 40, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.name: Use 1 to 100 characters.
errors.row: Name the row, in up to 16 characters.
errors.seats: List at least one seat, separated by commas.
errors.capacity: Use a whole number of places, from 1.
errors.summary: Some fields need a correction: see the messages beside them.
